before_after_agreement_fixed_four_way_va.definition: The identical cases with usable (format-valid) Luna-before, Qwen-before, Luna-after and Qwen-after review outputs.

luna.usage_scope: Actual saved generation usage only; separate input-count calls are excluded.

cost_accounting.basis: Provider responses echo 24h prompt-cache retention although this request option was omitted. A matching documented cache-write rate or invoice is unavailable. Exact cache-write and total charges are unknown. The inherited estimator includes 30m/12h scenarios; its partial priced-response sum is neither a total cost nor a defensible billing bound and is not reported as either.

qwen.usage_scope: Actual saved generation usage only; separate input-count calls are excluded.

cost_accounting.basis: The local API has no per-request charge. GPU allocation charges are unknown, so zero is not a total cost.
